headline: 2 teens dead, 1 injured in triple shooting in Scarborough
briefing: Top stories right now: 2 teens dead, 1 injured in triple shooting in Scarborough; Luxury home sales slump in Toronto, Vancouver, but top-end properties buck trend; and Ontario Liberals picked a Trudeau insider. Now Bains has to say what he’d do differently.

keyDates.label: Senate Democrats vote; Stelco recall
keyDates.why: Democratic senators choose between Chuck Schumer and Chris Van Hollen for majority leader by secret ballot, and 175 laid-off Stelco workers are due back in Hamilton.

keyDates.label: Bank of Canada and Fed rate decisions
keyDates.why: Both central banks decide the same day; the Bank of Canada has said more hikes are possible.

keyDates.label: U.S. government funding deadline
keyDates.why: Federal funding runs out unless the outgoing Congress passes a spending bill or a temporary extension, which is also the likeliest vehicle for any new air traffic control money.

stories.headline: 2 teens dead, 1 injured in triple shooting in Scarborough
stories.summary: Toronto police are investigating a triple shooting that happened overnight in Scarborough. Emergency crews were called to a Petro Canada gas station in the area of Ellesmere and Brimley Roads just after 12:30 a.m. on Sunday for reports of three males who were shot.
